## Aptera was built for the journey. The Camping Kit helps you make the most of the destination.


The Aptera Camping Kit transforms your solar electric vehicle into a comfortable basecamp, making it easier than ever to turn a day trip into an overnight adventure. Whether you’re chasing a sunrise hike, escaping to the mountains for the weekend, or finding a quiet place to camp beneath the stars, the Camping Kit helps you make the most of every mile.


See the Camping Kit in action and imagine where your next adventure could take you.


There’s a particular kind of freedom that comes from knowing your vehicle can do more than get you there. Find a place worth staying a little longer, pitch a tent, and let the sun add miles while you enjoy the adventure.


With Aptera, your vehicle doesn’t stop working when the drive ends.


## **Your adventure vehicle, powered by the sun**


Aptera’s integrated solar technology can add up to 40 miles of range per day from sunlight alone. Park at a campsite, trailhead, or scenic overlook, and your vehicle can continue gathering energy while you explore, relax, or sleep.


Return to your Aptera with more range than when you parked, powered entirely by the sun.


That capability opens new possibilities for spontaneous road trips, remote destinations, and weekends off the grid. Instead of planning your adventure around fuel stops or charging infrastructure, you can spend more time enjoying the journey.


## **Pack your adventure**


Whether you’re heading out for a single night or a week-long getaway, Aptera is designed to carry the gear that gets you there. Pack your hiking boots, camp stove, extra layers, trail snacks, surfboard, camera equipment, and more.


The Camping Kit gives you a comfortable place to recharge after a day of exploring, while the sun helps recharge your Aptera for tomorrow’s journey.


## **Adventure on your terms**


The best adventures don’t always happen according to plan. Sometimes they’re a last-minute decision to follow a trail you’ve never explored or spend an extra night somewhere beautiful.


The Aptera Camping Kit was designed for those moments.


Go farther. Stay longer. Explore more.
